full_panel.description: Registered hippocampal Figure5 scope: original rat1 complete2000-observation32D/36-cosine-neighbor decoding traces, means and SD for MARBLE/CEBRA-time/CEBRA-behavior; Figure5a source recording/behavior identities; Figure5b three-dimensional representations; original Figure5d paired contrasts; Figure5e original directed animal-pair alignment/R-squared results and ordering; referenced SupplementaryFigure5 preprocessing robustness controls. Exact original trace/contrast/pair identities and supplemental setting grid are not recovered. The current scalar/categorical schema cannot represent that required R-squared vector; scalar findings alone do not cover the complete original panel. Other MARBLE RNN/synthetic/macaque experiments are outside this registered task. Existing1999-row/four-rat clean/half-neuron extension cannot replace any original panel.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions must receive identical authenticated original neural observations, time/row identities and allowed source-specific training labels; author code is the only additional information in paper_data_author_code. MARBLE is described as unsupervised, CEBRA-time uses time, and CEBRA-behavior uses position/direction labels. Historical checkpoint label access, paper-wide PCA versus training-only notebook PCA, query neural context and exact fit/query membership remain unresolved; do not silently substitute the prospective train-only extension. Original targets/data are public, and isolation cannot establish unseen-target status.

blocking_issues: Original rat1 Figure5d2000 query identities, decoder training membership and rat1-to-Achilles join are not authenticated; later helper1999-row support is not equivalent.
Paper PCA5 over animal data versus decoding notebook train-only PCA20 and training PCA10, physical smoothing units and representation/query access remain unresolved.
Original numerical mean/SD values, source SD convention, original paired contrast mapping/statistics and dependence-aware reproduction criteria are unadmitted.

Figure5b original3D representations, Figure5c full decoded traces and Figure5e original animal-pair identities, alignment artifacts and complete pairwise R-squared vectors are missing; complete original controls cannot be replaced by the clean/half-neuron extension.
The referenced SupplementaryFigure5 exact Gaussian-kernel/PCA setting grid and output curves are not held; those companions cannot be declared reproduced.
Released checkpoint routes do not establish byte identity, trained population, label exposure, historical recipe or competent native author execution.

The accepted endpoint CLI emits mean, population/sample SD and input pins, but no saved per-observation decoded predictions/errors and no independent authentic-data derivation verifier. Its decode function returns2000 predictions only in memory.

No authenticated original input/identity manifests, complete paired participant delivery, code-only difference manifest, source-grounded tolerance, cumulative episode budget or complete granular verification policy exists. Admission policy and pairing therefore remain unspecified.
Generated controls and operator source checks establish neither AI computational reproduction nor improvement; printed source claims alone are insufficient.

The required Figure5e per-method source-target R-squared matrix is a source-native vector. No original scalar reduction has been authenticated and none is invented; the scalar/categorical finding schema leaves this mandatory output unrepresented. This engineering limitation is distinct from missing authentic source identities, numerical arrays and criteria, and must be resolved before complete-panel admission.
